summary.text: AKL scored 334-8 in their innings with Bevon Jacobs as top scorer with 202 off 137 balls, while Luke Georgeson (c) took 2 for 41 as the best bowling against them. OTG replied with 338-5, led by top scorer Max Chu (wk) with 75 off 55 balls against Ryan Harrison who took 2 for 68, resulting in Otago winning by 5 wkts.
